hero.title: Snap a rate-con. Get paid faster.
hero.subtitle: RateCon turns your rate confirmations into branded invoices in under 60 seconds. Built for Canadian owner-operators.

extract.title: AI extraction
extract.body: Snap a photo. We pull broker, load number, pickup, delivery, and rate — automatically.

tax.title: GST/HST done right
tax.body: Interprovincial freight zero-rated. Intraprovincial taxed at the destination's rate. We handle the CRA rules so you don't have to.

tracking.title: Unpaid loads, tracked
tracking.body: See every load that's overdue. Send reminders without leaving the app.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Simple monthly plans. 14-day free trial, no card required.

items.q: Do I need to be GST/HST registered?
items.a: No. If you're a small supplier under $30,000/year you can skip tax entirely. We'll respect the setting.
